utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, do you happen to know the exact drop-off times for the repair drive? I want to make sure we don't miss it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don't know the exact times off the top of my head—let me double-check with the organizers and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana. I'd appreciate that—just let me know when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, I'm heading to the garage to grab my toolbox — want me to bring anything specific for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just your basics — screwdrivers, pliers, a multimeter. That should cover most jobs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, basics it is. I'll be back in a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Vik, did you hear about the repair drive? I'm thinking of bringing in that old lamp of mine—maybe they can get it working again!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Tess, you're planning to come on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence, right? I'm bringing my toolbox and some spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that's the one! I'll be there too with my lamp. Glad you're bringing your tools—maybe you can help out with some of the fixes!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I'm planning to go. I've been keeping a list of what tools we have and what we might need to borrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'll bring the boards. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli! Could you also grab some extra screws if you have any?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, the repair drive is happening at the community center. They're collecting old bikes and appliances to fix up, plus any spare parts or tools you can donate.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, okay, bikes and appliances. So I should bring my old toaster then?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, bring that toaster! They'll take any small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Rey, I heard from Gus there's a repair drive going on—do you know if they're still taking in bikes with broken chains?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure, Nell. I haven't heard much about it yet—what did Gus say?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: He just said he heard about it and offered to bring his toolbox, but didn't say if they're taking broken chains.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I just heard the repair drive's moved to Sunday at the community center. Still planning to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? That's not what I had down. I've got the blueprints and Gus's toolbox set for Saturday; I better double-check with Vik.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I just heard from Rosa — it's definitely Sunday now at the community center. I can help you carry stuff over if you need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Faye. I heard the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wait, I thought it was still Saturday. Let me check with Bo to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, well I just got a note from Rosa saying it's definitely Sunday now, so I think we're good.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's a neighborhood thing! I've been spreading the word myself—sorry you missed the flyers. We'd love to have you join us Saturday morning!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm already planning to help with the lawnmower—Sam's going to lend a hand clearing the shed. What time should I be there Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're starting at 9 AM, but feel free to come anytime that morning! See you there!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, you hear about that repair drive at the community center? I just ran into Vik and he said it's really picking up steam.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Oh, right, I think I heard something about that... but I'm a bit fuzzy on the details. What's it for again?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's to fix up the old playground equipment and benches in the park — folks are donating tools and time. Vik says they're even getting a hardware store discount.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Mina! I was just thinking about the drive. We've got volunteers like Gus with his toolbox and Opal with her mower project — it's going to be quite a productive weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, so the repair drive is for the garden fence then? I thought we were fixing household items.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it's for both! The fence is one of the projects, but we're also fixing household items like Gus's toolbox and Opal's mower.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, a repair drive? Who organized that? I didn't see any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think Vik mentioned it—something about fixing up bikes and stuff at the community center on Saturday. I might've forgotten the details, though.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Vik mentioned it? Huh, that's odd. Are you sure it's happening? I feel like I'd have heard something official.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Rosa, I just heard they're even taking old lamps and toasters at that repair drive this weekend! You got anything broken lying around?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, I should let you know we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead. Still collecting all those items though!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday works even better for me! I've got that old blender that's been sitting in the cupboard for ages—finally time to see if they can bring it back to life.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh, I see. So it is the garden fence. I'll bring my hammer and some extra wire.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hammer and wire? Right, right—now I remember, it's the fence we're fixing. I'll bring my rusty old screwdriver, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Every little bit helps. See you Saturday at the fence.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope we have enough volunteers to haul everything. And do we have a plan for sorting the items?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry, I'll bring my toolbox and can help sort too. We'll figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, Gus. But what about the drop-off times? I don't want folks showing up at all hours with no one to receive their stuff.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Rosa just told me it's for the community center this Saturday—tools and all sorts of fixes, not just bikes or chairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Quinn mentioned it's the same day as the shed repair—roof and door work. I can help out, but it's going to be a busy Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh good, you heard too—Quinn's definitely got a full day planned. I'll make sure the tool sign-ups aren't overlapping so we don't run short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara! The repair drive's all about fixing up old bikes and appliances—neighbors pooling tools and parts at the community center. You interested in lending a hand?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You bet, Jules! I already roped Gus into the morning shift with his toolbox. The drive's this Saturday, 9 to 4—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Mara! Gus with his toolbox will be a huge help. I'll round up a few more folks from the book club to come by too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, just so you know, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll be there with my tools—need any help getting set up?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, what repair drive was that again? I feel like I keep missing something.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, it's the community repair event—someone’s organizing it to fix small appliances and stuff. It's now on Sunday at the community center. Want to come?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, looks like I’ve got good timing—just heard the drive moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, Dane, are you sure? I had it marked for Saturday at the garden shed—let me double-check my notes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm sure—Rosa told me it's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Rey, I heard the repair drive is for bikes and appliances—are we still keeping it to that, or did it expand to other things?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hmm, I think it's still just bikes and small appliances, but I'm not entirely sure. I did see that flyer but didn't read all the details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, let's double-check the flyer—I don't want to assume anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, 9 at the school lot. I'll see you there, then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I'll bring some extra tools just in case. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I heard Quinn mention it, but I'm still not convinced—where's the official sign-up or notice?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: There's no official sign-up, I've just been telling folks personally! We'll meet at the garden at 8 AM, tools provided—just bring your good vibes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but who's actually in charge of this thing? I need a name before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Uli, I've got this old bike with a busted chain—think they'll be able to help me out at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Probably yeah, they're handy folks. I'm bringing boards for the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear they're handy. Maybe they can work some magic on my chain too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, you're coming on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Got a toaster that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so you're coming on Saturday for the repair drive at the garden fence.
